title: Friend's government contact warns him off the Kandahar giant

tellings.quote: asked him he said hey do you know anything about like this Kandahar giant thing and he said this person who's his friend just totally switched

plain: A government insider is said to have "totally switched" and gone cold when asked about the "Kandahar giant", a story that US troops in Afghanistan killed a 12-foot giant in the early 2000s. Tim Alberino, a guest who tells the giant story, relays this from a friend who asked the question of a contact. If it is true, the subject touched a nerve inside the government.
